description: Source code for the QuicheDataWriter class, which handles writing various data types and variable-length integers to a buffer, with support for endianness and encoding optimizations.

classes.name: QuicheDataWriter
classes.description: A class for serializing data into a buffer with support for various integer sizes, string pieces, padding, and variable-length encoding.

methods.name: WriteUInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer to the buffer, converting to network byte order if needed.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the buffer, converting to network byte order if needed.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer to the buffer, converting to network byte order if needed.

methods.name: WriteBytesToUInt64
methods.description: Writes a specified number of bytes from a 64-bit integer to the buffer, handling endianness.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece16
methods.description: Writes a string with a 16-bit length prefix.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece
methods.description: Writes a string directly to the buffer.

methods.name: BeginWrite
methods.description: Prepares a pointer for writing a specified length of data into the buffer.

methods.name: WriteRepeatedByte
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a repeated byte.

methods.name: WritePadding
methods.description: Pads the buffer with zeros up to capacity.

methods.name: WritePaddingBytes
methods.description: Writes a specified number of zero bytes.

methods.name: WriteTag
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit tag to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer as a 62-bit variable-length integer.

methods.name: WriteStringPieceVarInt62
methods.description: Writes a string with a varint62 length prefix.

methods.name: GetVarInt62Len
methods.description: Determines the length of a varint62 encoding for a given value.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62WithForcedLength
methods.description: Encodes a value as a varint62 with a specified length.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified length.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the buffer's capacity and current length.
